summary: WorldEntity primary PR #293 exact head 83a1130c0424404a85dbb3d61623b2fb3e34f06d is not integration-ready despite green canonical CI and live Swarm ownership. The source now generically safe-bounds origin.generatorVersion at 2^53-1 and tests assert MAX_SAFE_INTEGER acceptance, but canonical deterministic generationVersion is normatively limited to [1, 2147483647]. The head therefore still admits provenance that SeedStream replay rejects. Replace the bound/tests with the deterministic contract range, then re-run exact-head checks before audit clearance.
evidence: PR #293 head 83a1130c0424404a85dbb3d61623b2fb3e34f06d cloneOrigin routes generatorVersion through assertNonNegativeInteger, whose upper bound is MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991.
The same head's world_entity_registry_shape suite explicitly expects MAX_SAFE_INTEGER generatorVersion to be accepted by new() and registry registration.
Docs/DETERMINISM_CONTRACT.md and DeterminismContract.seedFor require generationVersion in [1, 2147483647]. ResolvedRegionRecipe already mirrors this exact bound in Reality-layer source.
Canonical CI run 31468082655 and Swarm Control Plane run 31468082610 are green on this head, demonstrating the remaining issue is a missing semantic regression rather than tooling/ownership failure.
